Could not find compatible versions

Because g0 < 3.0 depends on g1 >= 1.0, < 3
  and g0 >= 3.0 depends on g3 = 2.0.beta,
  either g1 >= 1.0, < 3 or g3 = 2.0.beta.
And because g1 >= 2.0 depends on g3 ~> 1.0,
  either g3 ~> 1.0 OR = 2.0.beta or g1 >= 1.0, < 2.0.
And because every version of g2 depends on g3 >= 2.0
  and g1 < 2.0 depends on g4 = 2.0.beta,
  every version of g2 requires g4 = 2.0.beta.
So, because g4 = 2.0.beta could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally
  and Gemfile depends on g2 >= 0,
  version solving has failed.
